title: Calibrating the Alarms: A Registry-Grounded, Human-Validated Measurement of Poisoning Detectors on 16,763 MCP Tool Descriptions
description: Version 1.1.0 is the manuscript-matched archival release for a registry-grounded measurement study of 16,763 public Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool descriptions. It contains the frozen detector outputs, 150-row purposive human-review frame, full-text instance-level adjudication and PI sign-off records, matched source-neutral mocked-harness ablation ledger and sanitized transcripts, submission manuscript, and scripts that re-derive every quoted number. Detector outputs are candidates rather than verdicts; all support rates are explicitly sample-scoped. This version supersedes the v1.0.0 pre-paper snapshot and must be cited by its own version-specific DOI after publication.
